hits.title: Basel-based Chinese agribusiness firm Syngenta names new CEO snbchf.com
hits.snippet: The Swiss agrochemical company Syngenta Group is getting a new chief executive. The Board of Directors unanimously appointed Hengde Qin as the new Chief Executive Officer (CEO) starting August 1, the Basel-based company announced on Wednesday. The current Chief Operating Officer (COO) and head of the seeds division will succeed Jeff Rowe. Rowe will hand over the reins on August 1 after almost ten years with the company. He is planning to return to the US. According to a report from Reuters, people familiar with the situation indicated that the company, which is owned by the Chinese state-owned group Sinochem, is preparing for an initial public offering in Hong Kong. Stock exchange rules stipulate that following a change of leadership, a 60-day period must elapse before the prospectus for the listing can be submitted. Nevertheless, according to the person familiar with the situation, the IPO could still take place around the end of the year. Syngenta is sticking to its listing plans. Full story here Are you the author?

hits.title: Syngenta’s Jeff Rowe on making Big Ag less ‘easy to hate’ | Semafor
hits.snippet: Helping out on the 2,500-acre property, which his 82-year-old father still farms in denim overalls, has been just a side job for Rowe for some time. Since January 2024, he has been CEO of Syngenta, a Basel-based agrochemical giant owned by ChemChina with annual revenues approaching $29 billion and 56,000 people on its payroll. ... Rowe became CEO when Syngenta needed to tackle a cost base that was looking unsustainable. That meant focusing on the markets that mattered most to it, pulling back from others, and cutting about 4,000 jobs. “I wasn’t sure as a new CEO how that message was going to land,” he says, but he began with a policy of transparency, sharing details of the company’s cash flow issues and debt that many employees had been unaware of. “I told them, ‘I don’t want anyone to panic when you see these numbers, but I want you to see these numbers.’”

I feel fortunate to lead a company with deep Swiss roots, an international outlook, world-class science, and exceptional people. Yet what makes Syngenta Group truly special is our shared purpose: breakthroughs for farmers, in every field. I will lead with humility, openness and a willingness to listen. Staying close to farmers, customers, partners and colleagues will always be important to me. Together, we can help farmers achieve higher yields with lower impact and contribute to food security. Looking ahead, our strategic direction is clear, and our commitment to farmers, innovation and our people is as strong as ever. We have solid foundations, an important mission and a tremendous opportunity to help define the future of agriculture. Agriculture has always been about generations, not quarters. His appointment was the result of a selection and succession planning process. ... The new CEO will be based in Basel, Switzerland, where he has been working since January 2023. Qin has been a member of the Syngenta Group’s executive team since 2020. During this time, he has served as Chief Financial Officer, Chief Human Resources Officer, and President of Syngenta Group China, and has also become a member of the company’s Board of Directors. Under his leadership, Syngenta’s Chinese business has significantly increased its profitability and has become one of the group’s most successful divisions.

response.note: These name Hengde Qin as Syngenta Group CEO effective/starting August 2026; rank 4 lacks any date, rank 7 gives no date, rank 10 misspells the name as 'Hende Qin', rank 9 predates and names Rowe.
